jobs.description: 총괄표제부 kind Gold as a table of appended row versions (root ADR-0450, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh parcel-register-masters → publisher build-parcel-register-masters-versions): gold.parcel_register_masters_versions, computed by DuckDB inside the publisher (record_kind_stage::REGISTER_MASTERS) and appended as the keys whose digest changed (a removal marker for a key that left), each commit one version_seq. The lane's table since its takeover (the Spark gold_parcel_register_masters_rebuild and gold.parcel_register_masters's writes ended with it; takeover_equal was equal in 시도 41 on run 20261123T133232Z): it reads every input at its head. Nothing to do when its inputs, the served parcel edition and its code are the base commit's. A change of the code change table, the served edition or the code rebuilds every PNU; otherwise only the PNUs whose current sites or served parcels changed (KindVersionsStage::changed_pnus). by_pnu_parcel_register_masters_bake bakes its commits.
jobs.memory_measured: its own: run 20261123T133232Z of foundation-gold-versions@parcel-register-masters (2026-11-23 13:32-13:36Z, every served parcel's 583,561 총괄표제부 rows in 17 시도, 581,357 current rows, no key changed, 236 s), the publisher's cgroup memory peak in its run log 3,068,297,216 bytes; its first build, run 20261122T083831Z (one statement, 581,357 rows committed in 49 s), peaked at 2,545,446,912 bytes
jobs.memory_headroom_why: The peak follows the cap, not the work: the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (gold_versions_support MEMORY_SHARE), so a larger memory_max would only raise the peak. The run fit: no timeout, under MemoryMax

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: the first shadow build holds every key, so it reads the served parcel edition's PNUs (about 40 million, the read parcel-nearby's full build also makes, p90 1,502 s with its spatial work) and 621,193 sites (2026-11-09) and folds them in one statement; without the spatial work about 900 s, inside the 60-minute limit. Later runs rebuild the changed PNUs only.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: Reflect each new commit of gold.parcel_register_masters_versions (the own-producer 총괄표제부 kind, root ADR-0450) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-register-masters), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9), exactly as the ownership bake. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2). Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_register_masters_versions_build commits; the first bake after the takeover is a full generation with a content check against the served one (root ADR-0564 §6-5), and at 11:05 as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the ownership bake's bound (root ADR-0138).

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own bakes measured in its cut-over's bake step (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh parcel-register-masters bake, the same by-pnu-serving-bake.sh): 277 s on 2026-11-09 for 581,357 documents; the first scheduled bake after the publish may cut a whole generation (no reads.jsonl yet, root ADR-0468 §4), so 900 s, inside the 6,210 s share of the 115-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

assets.title: 필지 총괄표제부 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지의 건축물대장 총괄표제부(대지·건축·연면적, 주용도, 주·부속 건축물 수, 총주차수, 허가·착공·사용승인일)를 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0450). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-register-masters)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, silver.building_register_master 의 현재 행에서 만든다. 서빙 필지판의 PNU만, 바뀐 필지만 다시 계산한다. 넘겨받기(루트 ADR-0564 §6-4) 뒤로는 쓰지 않고 남긴다(쌓기만 한다): 레인은 gold.parcel_register_masters_versions 를 굽는다.

assets.title: 필지 총괄표제부 by-PNU 표(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지의 건축물대장 총괄표제부를 담는 표(루트 ADR-0450)를 판을 쌓는 표로(루트 ADR-0564 §1·§2): gold.parcel_register_masters 의 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더해 바뀐 PNU 의 행만 덧붙인다. 현재 행은 PNU 마다 version_seq 가 가장 큰 행이고 row_state 가 removed 면 그 PNU 는 없다. 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 계산하고 발행기가 추가 커밋으로 붙인다. 레인이 굽는 표다(넘겨받기, 루트 ADR-0564 §6-4): 입력의 머리로 짓는다.

assets.title: 필지 총괄표제부 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_register_masters_versions 의 현재 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/register-masters/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0450). 첫 발행은 자동 승격(루트 ADR-0435)이 한다.

dependencies.description: 현재 총괄표제부 행(관리건축물대장PK 마다)을 서빙 법정동 코드로 다시 매겨 서빙 필지판의 PNU 에 접는다(DuckDB, 루트 ADR-0450). 행이 바뀐 PNU 만, 양쪽 모두(옮긴 대지는 옛 PNU 를 떠난다) 다시 짓는다.
서빙 필지판의 PNU 가 문서의 전체 집합이다(루트 ADR-0292). 들고 난 필지만 다시 짓는다.
재편으로 바뀐 코드의 행을 서빙 코드로 읽는다(루트 ADR-0329 §3). 이 표가 바뀌면 모든 PNU 를 다시 짓는다.
레인의 굽기가 이 표의 현재 행을 읽는다(넘겨받기, 루트 ADR-0564 §6-4). 넘겨받은 뒤 첫 굽기는 서빙 세대와 내용을 견주는 전량 세대다(§6-5).
